rules.statement: The mere fact that Dingiri Banda is identified as a close relative of Siyathuhamy is insufficient by itself to make the information about his mother relevant in terms of section 32(5) of the Evidence Ordinance in view of the contradictory nature of the evidence before court on this issue.
rules.supporting_quote: Therefore, I hold that the details of the mother of Siyathuhamy set out in the death certificate (4D4) are not relevant in terms of section 32(5) of the Evidence Ordinance.
